reason: I've never heard of this and no salon owner I know or my distributor uses it, so I won't put ₹5,000 down plus ₹999 every month on it. My notebook and WhatsApp work fine for now.
objection: If the app stops working on a busy Sunday with walk-ins waiting, who do I call? I don't know these people and nobody I trust has tried them.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another salon owner nearby use it for a few months and tell me support picks up the phone fast, especially on weekends.
